text:
Aj Patel: Post-bake update: I pushed qkernel v0.9.3 to staging a few mins ago. Planning a short smoke + pin during the night window. any objections?
Maria Vasquez: quick q — did the matmul microbench match the pre-bake numbers?
Aj Patel: matmul perf is within 2% of pre-bake on p4s, memory transient looks fine. saw one minor jitter in 2/120 samples.
Zach Hill: saw the jitter in prom traces too, but only in one region (eu-west-1). suspected thermal bump on 2 hosts, not kernel-specific.
Lee Wang: CI smoke in staging is running now. will report pass/fail.
ci-bot: CI: staging-smoke qkernel:v0.9.3 started (build 4821). tests: smoke, kv-cache, sanity.
ci-bot: CI: staging-smoke qkernel:v0.9.3 finished — 11 passed, 1 flaky (timeout on kv-cache w/ long prompt).
Emily Rivera: can we hold the pin until kv-cache re-run completes? I want to avoid a cache-related rollback at 2am.
Aj Patel: fair. re-run kv-cache now. if green we'll pin with short TTL (4h) and then extend after perf deck verified.
ci-bot: CI: rerun kv-cache (build 4822) — passed.
Maria Vasquez: telemetry sanity: latency P95 is +10ms vs baseline, error rate unchanged. Send/receive token counts matched.
Zach Hill: deploying smoke canary to 10% of staging nodes to validate cross-host behavior for 30m.
deploybot: DeployBot: preflight OK. plan: pin qkernel:v0.9.3 -> night-window bucket (02:00-04:00). command to pin:
```
/deploybot pin qkernel:v0.9.3 --ttl=4h --bucket=night-window --reason "post-bake smoke + fallback"
```
Aj Patel: I'm going to run the pin at 01:50 UTC if no more objections. leaving 25m for last checks.
Lee Wang: +1 from ops, have rollback playbook ready.
Emily Rivera: I'll draft a one-paragraph release blurb and update release-notes PR (link: https://git.internal/release-notes/pull/314).
Maria Vasquez: rollback criteria (proposal): if token-error-rate > 0.5% for 15m OR P95 latency regression > 30% for 10m then rollback; also any KV cache miss spike correlated with increased tail latency.
Aj Patel: agree. lower bar for immediate rollback for user-facing errors. we should annotate the pin with those criteria.
deploybot: DeployBot: pin scheduled by Aj Patel at 1719981000 UTC. TTL=4h. annotation: "post-bake night-window pin — rollback if ERR>0.5% (15m) or P95>30%(10m) or kv-cache misses spike"
Zach Hill: copying smoke checklist here: 1) smoke ok on staging 2) canary 10% for 30m 3) trace sampling enabled 4) perf deck run 5) release note + support blurb ready.
Aj Patel: perf deck job kicked (long run), will take ~45m. if green we extend pin to 8h and start gradual regional cutover tomorrow.
Emily Rivera: FYI I'll add a support Slack ping template to the release-notes PR.
Maria Vasquez: thumbs for observability: added extra alert for kv-cache miss rate (threshold 2 sigma above baseline) and an A/B toggle to revert kernel selection per host.
Lee Wang: Ops runbook link: https://wiki.internal/ops/runbooks/qkernel-rollback. includes commands and health-check snippets.
Aj Patel: thanks all — if nothing else holler, I'll pin at 01:50. otherwise we'll monitor closely and unpin early if signals move. :thumbsup:
